Sustainability-led Transformation in Business and Society

Towards a Sustainable Future: reimagining society through innovation, inclusion, and impact

International Conference, SLTBS 202625 to 27 February 2026Campus View and Sky View, Hosur Road campus

Three days, one shared question

How can business grow without leaving people or the planet behind? Academics, researchers, industry experts, and students came together in hybrid mode to present research, debate in panels, and learn in workshops.

3days, 9 am to 5 pm
109attendees
64papers presented
170authors
11conference tracks

Of the 64 papers, 29 were presented on campus and 35 online.

Why this conference matters

Organisations and communities face climate change, economic inequality, and resource scarcity. SLTBS 2026 gave researchers and practitioners a place to share studies, case analyses, and new business models that balance economic growth with social and environmental responsibility.

It also built bridges between universities, corporations, and policy institutions, so that ideas can turn into research collaborations, sustainable business initiatives, and policy recommendations.

Pre-conference workshop

The Econometrician's Blueprint: From Data Foundations to Causal Discovery. A hands-on session with study materials and software, covering data structures and regression analysis, qualitative response models, causal inference, endogeneity, and instrumental variables.

Professor and Dean, MBA, Global Academy of Technology

Publishing the work

All accepted papers are hosted on SSRN, owned by Elsevier, as conference proceedings. Selected papers were forwarded to partner journals for review, including the Sustainability Accounting, Management and Policy Journal (Emerald), The Journal of Business Perspective (Sage), and Studies in Economics and Finance (Emerald).

Proceedings with an ISBN were released at the conference.
